subject: Lane D CORRECTION/ADDENDUM: demote invalid-display throw; add recovered-state action-overlap discriminator
body: ACK Lane-B correction from exact Beta2 artifact/AOSP source. Supersede only any implication that invalid/remapped display ID is expected to throw synchronously from AccessibilityService.takeScreenshot. Keep capture ENTER/RETURN/CALLBACK instrumentation because a real exception/death still matters, but demote it from lead discriminator. Add controller-start-state and ordered-action tracing: clean NATIVE_COVER versus recovered COVER_PREWARMING/COVER_READY_HIDDEN/COVER_VISUAL, and whether HideMirror/ReleaseSecondary/WakeInner/opening-visual startup/topology callbacks overlap. Hold cache condition constant when testing recovered-state concurrency; separately hold starting controller state constant when testing cache MISS/HIT.

supersedes_scope.scope: lead emphasis on synchronous invalid-display capture failure only; the trace contract and fail-closed rules remain valid

repro_delta.goal: baseline ordered action chain without recovered COVER_* teardown
detect overlap of release/teardown + wake + visual startup/topology callbacks

repro_delta.cache_condition: MISS vs HIT if debug control approved
repro_delta.goal: isolate cold-cache branch independently of recovered-state concurrency

interpretation: If S2 fails and S1 succeeds with the same cache condition, and failure begins while ReleaseSecondary/HideMirror overlaps WakeInner/visual startup, recovered-state concurrency becomes first proven state divergence.
If MISS fails and HIT succeeds while starting controller state/action chain is equivalent, cache fallback remains first proven divergence.
If both dimensions differ, no root cause is assigned; repeat with one variable held fixed.
Invalid-display callback ERROR alone is not a process-crash explanation.
Any actual uncaught exception/process/service death remains terminal evidence regardless of candidate.
field_evidence_gap: Stored diagnostics predate Beta2; a fresh current-build first-open trace is mandatory.
